# R04 — lengthwise coordination, for review

The user selected a 320 ordinary complete support/base reservation and asked to proceed without profiles. The accepted clearance rule keeps all masonry, shafts and bases outside the full reserved vault spaces. No profile research or modeling is performed here.

This bounded experiment compares the N6 main-vessel reference clear length of 3600 with two 1800 lower-vault clear lengths. The ordinary support width is 320. Using 320 at every boundary gives a main-vessel pitch of 3920 and a paired lower-vault pitch of 4240, a 320 discrepancy per major bay. It cannot be called a single aligned repeating grid.

## Candidate requiring a user decision

Keep the common pitch at 4240. This gives each 3600 main vault a **640 longitudinal boundary gap**, while each 1800 lower cell keeps a 320 gap. At the main/A1 interface, reserve a major junction rectangle **640 along X by 320 across Y**; intermediate ordinary reservations remain **320×320**. All clear rectangles keep their size. Their corner bearing points differ by 160 along X on opposite faces of the major reservation.

The extra length is a deliberate proposed exception at major stations, not a silent increase in the selected ordinary 320 allowance. The 320 transverse band from R03 stays unchanged, so R03's local transverse width chain is not enlarged by this proposal. No final pier shape is designed, nor is the major reservation adequate merely because it has room in plan.

Two consecutive common-pitch modules are drawn to check repeatability. Their main clear rectangles have local X ranges 320–3920 and 4560–8160. The lower rectangles are 160–1960, 2280–4080, 4400–6200 and 6520–8320. Main-vessel width is 5866 and A1 width is 1152. Only the north main/A1 interface is drawn. The PNG crops the main vessel to its north edge for legibility; the native SVG and checkpoint preserve its full width. This is not a generated vault model.

All of these locations are new experimental placements. No original model is translated or saved over, no original vault shape is resized, and no approved coordinate array or generator is changed. F5ZK-C/F5ZN-A, all 14 saved ambulatory vaults, Pass 6J and V13 originals remain protected. The missing F5ZL-C support schedule remains unresolved. The curved chevet and crossing are excluded.

## Validation and limits

Checks cover exact dimensions, polygon validity, zero positive-area masonry/reservation intrusion, ordinary and major gap widths, common pitch, and the distinct main/lower corner points lying on the major reservation boundary. Boundary-point contact is only a 2D coordination check; it does not prove physical bearing, spring-cluster bonding, profile fit or structural capacity. Saved JSON round-tripped and native SVG parsed. The rendered PNG is visually inspected before delivery.

The current proposed exception needs user review before any master-plan application. If the user requires every major junction also to remain within a complete 320-long envelope, this 4240 common-pitch candidate is not selected; the separate main/lower rhythms must remain unresolved pending another plan arrangement. Neither vault size may be stretched to conceal the discrepancy.

Reuses the R03 parameter record and dimensions already recovered during this ongoing study; no repeated source archive scans. Master Reference was read earlier in the same inward-development workflow and remains provisional. The R03 parent commit is recorded in PARAMETERS.json. Reproduce with `python build_lengthwise.py` (matplotlib and shapely). Once PARAMETERS.json exists, reproduction is self-contained. Numerical/native units remain 1:1; physical SI conversion is unresolved.
